issue.description: User-authorized extraction of the existing start launcher into the independent harness-start Forgejo repository. Plan: docs/plan/plan.md. Acceptance: standalone installer; signed automatic and explicit updates; configurable agent/model/permission/tmux defaults; offline updater, installer, CLI and real tmux validation; protected iad-ci Transit release workflow deployed through declarative-config; signed first release published and mirrored; bootstrap transition prepared/published without capturing concurrent checkout edits; installed launcher verified. One owning bead covers application source, bootstrap adoption and GitOps release manifests. No speculative child work.
issue.notes: Standalone launcher, generated authenticated installer, explicit updates, agent-update control, user model/permission/tmux/workdir configuration, release tooling and signed-source bootstrap adoption are implemented. Extracted bootstrap origin/main 32993be. BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE=/home/coding/bootstrap scripts/check.sh passed all offline tests and actual private-server tmux runtime locally. gitleaks dir . --redact --no-banner passed, no leaks. GitOps paths: declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/harness-start-release-sign-workflowtemplate.yml and harness-start-bootstrap-adopt-workflowtemplate.yml; target iad-ci, ArgoCD argo-workflows-ns-iad-ci. Static YAML/shell/signing-token isolation passed. k8s/check-resource-limits.py iad-ci completed with 531 files, 269 pre-existing findings, 0 critical. Capacity script exited 0 but reported UNREACHABLE due to expired authentication; verify through read-only proxy. Shared source checkouts have concurrent edits/divergent refs; one short-lived shared-object checkout under scratch preserves them for delivery. Outstanding: signed publication, mirror convergence, bootstrap transition, installed release verification. Do not close.
